messages.author: a47e6c3cd0531db0
messages.subject: pbdDMAT memory allocation error
parts:
Hi all--

I'm sorry if this is a re-post, it looked like maybe my first attempt to post did not go through.

A co-worker and I have installed pbdDEMO (and dependencies) on a supercomputing cluster and are actively trying to use it for various projects.  However, we are running into memory allocation issues that I have been unable to debug.  I was wondering: have you had any similar issues in your own testing, and/or do you have any suggestions for how to track this down?

Here is an R script (mem_tests.R) that reproduces the error:

rm(list = ls())
library(pbdDMAT, quiet = TRUE)

init.grid()

ncols <- 1e3
nrows <- 2^(18:22)

for (i in 1:length(nrows)){
  comm.cat('Matrix dims : (', toString(nrows[i]), ',', toString(ncols), ')\n', quiet = TRUE)
  x.dmat <- ddmatrix(data = 0, nrow = nrows[i], ncol = ncols)
  xmem <- object.size(x.dmat)
  comm.cat('object.size(x.dmat) =', format(xmem, units = 'auto'), '\n', quiet = TRUE)
}

finalize()

The MPI call I am using is:

$ mpirun -np 2 Rscript mem_tests.R

where each MPI rank runs on a separate compute node with ~32 Gb memory each.

Here is the output:

$ mpirun -np 2 Rscript mem_tests.R
Using 2x1 for the default grid size

Matrix dims : ( 262144 , 1000 )
object.size(x.dmat) = 1000 Mb
Matrix dims : ( 524288 , 1000 )
object.size(x.dmat) = 2 Gb
Matrix dims : ( 1048576 , 1000 )
object.size(x.dmat) = 3.9 Gb
Matrix dims : ( 2097152 , 1000 )
object.size(x.dmat) = 7.8 Gb
Matrix dims : ( 4194304 , 1000 )
Error: cannot allocate vector of size 15.6 Gb
Execution halted

If I increase the number of ranks per core, the script fails for a matrix of smaller dimensions.

$ mpirun -np 4 Rscript mem_tests.R
Using 2x2 for the default grid size

Matrix dims : ( 262144 , 1000 )
object.size(x.dmat) = 500 Mb
Matrix dims : ( 524288 , 1000 )
object.size(x.dmat) = 1000 Mb
Matrix dims : ( 1048576 , 1000 )
object.size(x.dmat) = 2 Gb
Matrix dims : ( 2097152 , 1000 )
object.size(x.dmat) = 3.9 Gb
Matrix dims : ( 4194304 , 1000 )
Error: cannot allocate vector of size 7.8 Gb
Execution halted

For reference, I can run the exact same script -- with same MPI call -- on my MacBook Pro (16 Gb RAM) with no issues:

Using 2x1 for the default grid size

Matrix dims : ( 262144 , 1000 )
object.size(x.dmat) = 1000 Mb
Matrix dims : ( 524288 , 1000 )
object.size(x.dmat) = 2 Gb
Matrix dims : ( 1048576 , 1000 )
object.size(x.dmat) = 3.9 Gb
Matrix dims : ( 2097152 , 1000 )
object.size(x.dmat) = 7.8 Gb
Matrix dims : ( 4194304 , 1000 )
object.size(x.dmat) = 15.6 Gb

Any help tracking this issue down would be much appreciated!

Thanks in advance, 
--Dave

messages.author: 04ee6652802764c3
messages.subject: Re: pbdDMAT memory allocation error
parts:
Hi Dave,

Looks like you aren't specifying the number of cores per node.  In that case, that would definitely push against the memory bounds of a single 32 GiB node.

I tested this on one of our Crays, and I was able to recreate the crash by calling:

aprun -n 2 Rscript memtest.r

But not when I specify 1 core per node (command is specific to Cray's MPI implementation):

aprun -n 2 -N 1 Rscript memtest.r

Which produces the following output:

Using 2x1 for the default grid size

Matrix dims : ( 262144 , 1000 )
object.size(x.dmat) = 1000 Mb 
Matrix dims : ( 524288 , 1000 )
object.size(x.dmat) = 2 Gb 
Matrix dims : ( 1048576 , 1000 )
object.size(x.dmat) = 3.9 Gb 
Matrix dims : ( 2097152 , 1000 )
object.size(x.dmat) = 7.8 Gb 
Matrix dims : ( 4194304 , 1000 )
object.size(x.dmat) = 15.6 Gb

Application 861254 resources: utime ~74s, stime ~27s, Rss ~24623272, inblocks ~88688, outblocks ~98



With OpenMPI, the docs show that the command is:

mpirun -np 2 -npernode 1 Rscript memtest.r

Let me know how it goes.

--Drew

Thank you for the quick and helpful reply!

Cheers,
--Dave
